units.source_text: 且说住在桐壶院的那位明石女御，即皇太子妃明石小女公子，自从入宫之后，一直不曾归宁。

en.t: Now, the Akashi Consort who lived at Kiritsubo Palace, the young Lady Akashi who had become the Crown Prince's consort, had not once gone back to her family home since entering the palace.

units.source_text: 皇太子十分宠爱她，不许她乞假回家。

en.t: The Crown Prince loved her very dearly and would not allow her to ask leave to go home.

units.source_text: 她一向在家自由玩耍，如今闭居深宫，小小的心中颇感苦闷。

en.t: She had always played freely at home, but now she was shut away deep in the palace, and her young heart felt deeply oppressed.

units.source_text: 到了夏天，明石女御身体不适，然而皇太子不肯立刻放她回家，她就更加烦恼。

en.t: When summer came, the Akashi Consort became unwell, but the Crown Prince still would not let her go home at once, which made her even more distressed.

units.source_text: 她身体不适，看来是有喜了。

en.t: Her illness seemed to mean that she was pregnant.

units.source_text: 她今年还只十二岁，因此大家都很担心，把这看作一件大事。

en.t: She was only twelve years old that year, so everyone was very worried and regarded it as a grave matter.

units.source_text: 好容易请准了假，回六条院休养。

en.t: At last, after much effort, leave was granted, and she returned to Rokujo-in to rest and recover.

units.source_text: 她的房室位在三公主所居正厅的东面。

en.t: Her rooms were located to the east of the main hall where the Third Princess lived.

units.source_text: 她的生母明石姬现已经常随伴着她，自由出入宫禁，也真是难得的前生福报。

en.t: Her birth mother, the Lady Akashi, now often attended her and could freely enter and leave the palace precincts, a rare blessing indeed from a former life.

units.source_text: 紫姬要去探望明石女御，想乘便和三公主见面，对源氏说道：“教他们开了界门，让我乘便去望望三公主。

en.t: Lady Murasaki wanted to visit the Akashi Consort and, at the same time, meet the Third Princess, so she said to Genji, "Please have them open the boundary gate and let me take the opportunity to call on the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 我早就想去访问她，只因没有机会，至今尚未去得。

en.t: I have long wanted to visit her, but because there was no opportunity, I have still not been able to go.

units.source_text: 现在正好见见面，以后便可随意往还了。”

en.t: If I meet her now, we will be able to come and go freely from now on."

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“你这话正中我下怀。

en.t: Genji smiled and said, "Those words are exactly what I had hoped to hear.

units.source_text: 三公主还幼稚得很，你要多多教导她，好让她进步。”

en.t: The Third Princess is still very childish, so you should guide her well and help her improve."
He allowed the women to meet.

units.source_text: 紫姬觉得三公主还在其次，倒是和明石女御的母亲——那个容姿绝胜的明石姬——见面，要郑重些。

en.t: Lady Murasaki felt that the Third Princess was secondary; meeting the Akashi Consort's mother, the incomparably beautiful Lady Akashi, required rather more formality.

units.source_text: 便梳洗头发，精选服饰，打扮得花枝招展，美丽无匹。

en.t: So she washed and arranged her hair, chose her garments with care, and adorned herself like flowers in full bloom, beautiful beyond compare.
